[EN] Suryati threatens Acarum and all of Westonia. Countless soldiers better than I fell trying to stop him.

Is that why you're here?
[ES] Suryati amenaza a Acarum y a todo Westonia. Incontables soldados mejores que yo cayeron intentando detenerlo.

¿Es por eso que estás aquí?

[EN] I'm not ready to return...not yet.

You go on, .
[ES] No estoy listo para regresar... aún no.

Adelántate, .
